allow: Bash(powershell "Get-Process | Sort-Object WorkingSet -Descending | Select-Object -First 20 Name, @{Name=''Memory\(MB\)'';Expression={[math]::Round\($_WorkingSet / 1MB, 2\)}} | Format-Table -AutoSize")
Bash(cmd /c "systeminfo | findstr /C:""Total Physical Memory"" /C:""Available Physical Memory""")
